notes: Charging reworked: hold medium or heavy and you wind up before the throw (meter over your head), then let go and the blow comes straight out; a tap throws it normally. Finishers can't be dodged any more, only countered, and the counter now works on everything: supers need tight timing and finishers need it near-perfect. The finisher x-ray is quick again (one sharp snap). Blood now runs down your chest, abs and arms, and getting hit while hurt splashes blood on the screen; sweat drops on the screen look like real water. Bodies are smoother and more muscular: rounded limbs and torso under the sculpted muscles. Hoops: fixed corner shots teleporting to the rim (and a ball that could get stuck up top and freeze play), the green is now at the very top of the shot meter, and tired, sweaty players drip sweat on the floor. Rebirth now needs every stat maxed plus the cash.
